scope: A temporary compatibility copy of the preserved GPU attempts one four-thread vector-add block through dispatcher, program/data controllers, cores, registers, ALUs and LSUs. 11 explicit source adaptations remove trailing commas and express unpacked-array resets as all-zero assignment patterns. An additional experimental behavioral change resets the scheduler wait accumulator on every WAIT evaluation. Original files remain unchanged. External testbench memory uses a configurable response delay.

program.source:
LDR R1, [%threadIdx]
CONST R2, 64
ADD R2, R2, %threadIdx
LDR R3, [R2]
ADD R4, R1, R3
CONST R5, 128
ADD R5, R5, %threadIdx
STR R4, [R5]
RET
